high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of a news article with accompanying text and an image of the Apple logo. The text discusses a report from The Wall Street Journal (WSJ) about Apple's decision to abruptly pull out of negotiations for participating in a significant funding round for OpenAI, the artificial intelligence research lab behind ChatGPT. The funding round is expected to raise as much as $6.5 billion. The text highlights that this would have been a rare investment by Apple in another major Silicon Valley company.
